findings.span: The two frames are AI illustrations, not results.
findings.why: A two-frame skin visual on a pigmentation serum reads as a before/after pair even with the label, and ASCI's AI-labelling guidelines prohibit AI-made result images regardless of a label. Acceptable only if the frames are clearly not a skin-change comparison.
findings.fix: Replace the two AI skin frames with a pack shot or texture image and drop the 'two frames' line.

tone_read: Calm and factual, no fear or hype, and the AI disclosure is honest. The 'two frames' wording itself draws attention to a before/after-style visual, which is not Minimalist's education-first register.
language_read: Concentration stated exactly (2% Alpha Arbutin) and no unhedged efficacy words. The 'strength stated on the page' phrase is internal-sounding copy that a reviewer would likely trim.
